title: Microsoft Outlook: Search within a selected folder
summary: Outlook will allow users to limit search results to a selected mail folder, enhancing search control. This feature will roll out globally in mid-November 2026. No action or compliance concerns are required.
body:
[What and why]

Users can now select a mail folder and scope Outlook search results to that folder. This update gives users more control over their searches by helping them narrow results to a specific folder.

[Rollout schedule]

General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete in mid-November 2026.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users who use Outlook searchPlatforms and services

- OutlookWhat will happen

- Users will have folder selection options in Outlook search.- Users can select a mail folder and scope search results to that folder.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
